answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a bonded, non-transferable stake that only unlocks after sustained honest work. Each new wallet must post it, and it forfeits when attestations get sybil-linked, so N fake identities cost N times the stake plus the loss. Weight also grows sublinearly with history, so a thousand fresh wallets earn roughly what one mature wallet does and the attacker burns capital for near-zero payout. Clusters stay a ferrous lock that never warms, not an ember of credibility, and never reach the canyon of higher-tier rewards.
